gate_defs.label: Universe
gate_defs.what: only the underlyings the desk is authorised to trade

gate_defs.label: Expiry
gate_defs.what: no expiry inside the judging horizon or under min DTE

gate_defs.label: Defined risk
gate_defs.what: every structure's worst case must be finite and known

gate_defs.label: Liquidity
gate_defs.what: two-sided quotes, relative spread inside the limit

gate_defs.label: Structure size
gate_defs.what: one structure may not risk more than its share of equity

gate_defs.label: Portfolio worst case
gate_defs.what: book + candidate repriced over a +/-20% grid

gate_defs.label: Daily budget
gate_defs.what: new risk opened today against the day's allowance

gate_defs.label: Time window
gate_defs.what: no entries in the first or last minutes of a session

gate_defs.label: Drawdown halt
gate_defs.what: trading stops after a drawdown from the high-water mark

gate_defs.label: Event de-risk
gate_defs.what: no new risk inside the window before a high-class release

gate_defs.label: Sleeve budget
gate_defs.what: the long-premium sleeve has its own separate allowance

gate_defs.label: Feed freshness
gate_defs.what: stale or one-sided market data refuses the trade
